title: AngularJS Fundamentals In 60-ish Minutes
summary: Dan Wahlin's hour-long beginner course on AngularJS builds a small single-page app while covering SPAs, directives, filters and data binding. It gives an initial grounding in Angular 1.
why: HN recommended it as a good beginner screencast and as an example of the kind of tutorial other frameworks needed.

quote.text: I'd recommend sitting through Dan Wahlin's hour intro to Angular.
